items.difficulty_reason: Perfectness of Rf_*E for E bounded coherent with proper support and finite tor dimension: gets Rf_*E in D^b_Coh from lemma-direct-image-coherent, pseudo-coherent on Noetherian Y, reduces finite tor dimension via the tor-qc-qs lemma to boundedness of Rf_*E ⊗ F for all QCoh F; bounds above trivially, replaces X by a quasi-compact open X' containing the union of supports T (proper), and computes Rf_*E ⊗ F = Rf_*(E ⊗ f^{-1}F) via the base change and variant-pullback lemmas, which has cohomology in a finite range by assumption (3).
